name: print-social-gradient-glow-fee-breakdown-promo
title: Fee Breakdown Card on Blue Gradient
whatItIs: A promo card with a white panel listing project fees with green savings and a blue net total, plus a smaller overlapping pill card reading 'Plus no platform fee for your clients', over a deep teal-to-blue gradient.
whatItMeans: Real numbers inside a real-looking widget make the offer credible. Color coding, green for savings and blue for what you get, lets the eye follow the money story in seconds.
techniques: Use semantic color inside the UI: green for saved, blue for total, black for neutral
Strike-through the fee to show a discount visually
Add a secondary overlapping strip that delivers the punchline
Bottom-weighted gradient that brightens toward the foot of the frame
Large, rounded white cards that keep text legible against the vivid backdrop
bestFor: Explaining a value proposition with concrete numbers

vocabulary.definition: A small secondary card that carries the key claim or twist.
Color used to signal meaning, such as green for positive money.
A gradient that brightens toward the bottom of a frame.
